after.lib/contracts.ex:
defmodule Contracts do
  @doc "Evaluate an expression once and include its source in failure messages."
  defmacro check(expr) do
    source = Macro.to_string(expr)
    quote do
      if unquote(expr), do: :ok, else: raise("check failed: " <> unquote(source))
    end
  end
end
